title: Choose the one-screen landing · dark
question: Re-rolled with your steer: dark. Same drawing-set world on its dark blueprint ground. One screen: paper vs evidence, how it works, who it's for, the demo button.

options.label: The pipeline
options.lineage: a process drawing, read left to right
options.thesis: How it works is the hero: four connected stops on one dashed line, Read, Place, Count, Judge, each showing its own evidence, ending in 9 of 12 with its stamps. Headline and demo button above, who it's for along the foot.
options.viewport: Top: brand. Then a short headline and one sentence, the demo button at the right. Middle: four stops on a dashed orange line: the quoted claim, a room tag, four openings with two outlined, then 9 of 12 with Verified, Short and Not seen yet stamps. Foot: Builders, Buyers, Banks. Phone: headline, button, the four stops stacked on a vertical line.
options.risk: Four stops plus a headline is a lot for one screen; each stop has to stay to one picture and one line.

raised.raise: A chase light runs the line once on load, lighting each stop in turn, then rests on Judge.
Bold graphic argument: each stop is a picture first, words second.
Hierarchy by scale alone: the headline and the final number outrank everything.

options.label: The fold, condensed
options.thesis: Today's fold in the dark world and on one screen: dark paper with the letter's three bare lines on the left, the same lines stamped with the evidence frame on the right, the demo button on the seam, how it works and who it's for as one strip along the foot.
options.viewport: Left: brand, 'A demand letter says it's done.', three highlighted lines, one sentence. Right: 'The builder's own clips show it.', the same three lines stamped 9 of 12, 4 of 5, Not checked, and an evidence frame. The demo button on the dashed seam. Foot: Read, Place, Count, Judge, then who it's for. Phone: halves stack, button on the seam.
options.risk: Closest to the current page; it reads as the same idea, tightened.

options.label: The sheet with callouts
options.lineage: an engineering drawing with leader-line notes
options.thesis: One evidence frame at the centre of the sheet, Bedroom 2 with two windows outlined and two empty, stamped Short 2. How it works is four callouts with leader lines to what each step produced. Who it's for and the positioning line form the title block.
options.viewport: Left: brand, 'Every claim gets the frame that proves it.', one sentence, the demo button. Right: the quoted BOQ line over a large frame, stamp half off its corner; Read and Judge callouts to its right, Place and Count below. Foot: Builders, Buyers, Banks, and the positioning line. Phone: headline, button, frame, callouts as a list.
options.risk: Shows one room's evidence closely; the whole-flat answer (9 of 12) waits for the demo.

options.label: Moon-shadow bazaar
options.case: Declined: dreamlike is the opposite of evidence.

options.label: Tensegrity column
options.case: Declined: a metaphor where a real frame belongs.

options.label: Du Bois data portraits
options.case: Declined: its palette replaces the drawing set.

options.label: Blast manifesto
options.thesis: Slabs of type at right angles.
options.case: Declined: shouting fights 'payment support, not policing'.

options.label: HyperCard stack
options.case: Declined: monochrome drops the outcome colours.

options.label: Drum machine steps
options.thesis: Step keys under a chase light.
options.case: Declined: candy colours fight the outcome system.
options.kept: A chase light runs the steps.
